label: Stipulated addressed echo transcript and independent production history
definition: Message is the recipient, occasion and challenge token triple of an echo instruction. Responds means equality of the reply and challenge triples. History separates visible Message, origin producer identifier, origin production time, origin token, and prior token access lists. Integrity equates visible and produced tokens. Fresh excludes the challenge token from any earlier production. Disciplined requires the producer to have prior access to the produced token. Exclusive restricts access to the challenge token to the selected candidate. AuthoredNow requires the token producer to be the candidate and the production not precede the challenge occasion.
note: Analyst stipulated protocol, attribution deferred. Nat identifiers are primitive recipient/producer/occasion/token identities; the same selected candidate and challenge fix every comparison. Echo syntax gives minimal propositional/instructional content and mechanical matching only, not recipient understanding or intentional communication. Actual history/access lists are stipulated, not inferred from public testimony. Disciplined rules out successful guessing and is an open deterministic application assumption, not a law of ordinary cognition. No cryptographic security or probability. Event is this selected response production/delivery comparison; replay concerns an earlier production used as the current response. Delivery time/order beyond the selected occasion, relay agency, history completeness and divine identity remain OPEN. See docs/notes/revelation-positive-recognition.md. Integrity covers only token identity: full-message origin, address authorization and understood content remain open; AuthoredNow establishes only token production and its time restriction.
